title: Ethical-Lens: Curbing Malicious Usages of Open-Source Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the statistical distribution of male and female depictions in generated images using GPT-4V and FairFace classifiers, and calculating the L1 distance from a uniform distribution to assess imbalance.

Measuring the statistical distribution of various racial groups (e.g., White, Black, Latino-Hispanic, Asian, Middle Eastern) in generated images using GPT-4V and FairFace classifiers, and calculating the L1 distance from a uniform distribution.

Measuring the statistical distribution of different age groups (e.g., infancy, childhood, adolescence, young adulthood, middle age, old age) in generated images using GPT-4V and FairFace classifiers, and calculating the L1 distance from a uniform distribution.
